window_note: 25 ms Hann window (400 samples) zero-padded to an FFT of 512, hop 160 samples (10 ms)
padding_cropping: recordings longer than T are cropped (centre crop for evaluation, random crop for training); shorter ones are padded at the end with the training mean (0 after normalisation)
normalisation: per-Mel-band mean/std fitted on the TRAINING fold only
